text:
priya: dropping a new concept for bulk-approve with required justification rules and an optional "archive after approve" toggle. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/bulk-approve-justification-v1.png

sam: quick summary of flows?

priya: TL;DR: modal opens when you click "Approve selected". If count > 10, justification textarea becomes required. Add templates dropdown, autosave draft, and keyboard shortcut `Shift+Enter` to submit. Modal should trap focus and announce title to screenreaders.

elaine: microcopy: button labels need clarity. "Approve" vs "Approve and archive" — which is primary? I think primary should be action-focused: "Approve"; secondary "Approve & archive" might be less prominent but we should surface tooltip: "Archive removes items from active runs".

noah: a11y: use `<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="bulk-approve-title">` and set initial focus to the textarea or template menu. Also ensure Escape closes and restores previous focus.

priya: agreed. plan is to focus textarea when required, otherwise focus primary approve button. We'll set `aria-describedby` to include the rule copy: "Justification required for > 10 tests".

sam: validation + announcements: on submit failure (e.g., empty required field) announce error with `role="alert"` and move focus to the input with the error. Also have a inline char counter for textarea with `aria-live="polite"`.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: recommended contrast for secondary danger-like CTA (archive) must be >=4.5:1. Current red (#E04D4D) is 3.9:1 on white. Suggest #C93939 or add a 2px outline for focus state. Also mark the `textarea` with `aria-required="true"` when rule applies.

elaine: UX: autosave drafts are great but we need an unsaved-changes prompt if someone navigates away. Use a banner instead of native beforeunload to allow screenreader-friendly copy: "You have an unsaved justification draft. Continue editing? [Restore] [Discard]".

noah: undo semantics: propose a 30s undo window with a toast `role="status"`: "Approved 12 tests. Undo". Pressing Undo should reopen modal with previous selection and draft restored. Make toast keyboard-focusable.

priya: analytics events proposed in PR: (we'll include enums)
```
approve.bulk
approve.bulk.with_reason
approve.bulk.archive
approve.undo
```
Include `selected_count`, `justification_length`, `used_template` in payload.

sam: keyboard accessibility: `Shift+Enter` to submit, `Esc` to cancel, `T` opens templates menu, `U` for undo when toast focused. Also add visible hint in modal footer with shortcuts.

elaine: localization note: justification placeholder and templates may be long in some langs. Ensure multi-line labels and tooltips wrap and that buttons don't truncate—use full tooltip on hover/focus for truncated labels.

noah: performance: if selection is very large (1000+), we should show a warning and require a second confirmation step to avoid accidental mass approvals. This also affects analytics sampling.

priya: good call. new rule: >500 items -> require typed confirmation (type APPROVE) and disable archive toggle. We'll add that to copy and accessibility checks.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: typed-confirmation should include `aria-describedby` explaining why and ensure the input is labeled; prefer `role="alertdialog"` for the second-step confirm. Also make sure the typed string is not autocompleteable by password managers.

sam: dev question: how to restore focus after Undo flows? suggestion: when Undo reopens modal, set focus to primary CTA inside modal and announce "Restored selection of 12 tests" via `aria-live`.

elaine: copy nit: button text: pick one style: either ampersand or word. UX prefers words for screenreader clarity so use "Approve and archive". keep primary as just "Approve".

priya: action items: (priya) update mock with required justification rule and typed-confirmation state (2222223344), (sam) prototype dialog with `role=dialog` + `role=alert` error handling + keyboard shortcuts, (elaine) finalize microcopy for buttons/tooltips and localization notes, (noah) add 2nd-step confirm for >500 and test focus/undo flows. I'll add analytics enums to the PR description. Thanks :thumbsup:
